# [[BPR-1485]]. AC2 equivalence evidence: the product's diff over the
# RFC-BPR-0082 evaluation corpus, compared with the evaluation's recorded
# `l-myers-indent` outcomes and GitHub patches. A tool, not a ctest row: the
# corpus is generated by the retired harness's scripts and is not committed.
bpr_add_executable(tool_diff_xdiff_equivalence
    xdiff_equivalence.cpp
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/evaluation/diff_engine/harness/oracle.cpp")
target_include_directories(tool_diff_xdiff_equivalence PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/evaluation/diff_engine")
target_link_libraries(tool_diff_xdiff_equivalence PRIVATE BetterPullReview::Core bpr_test_product_diff)
